blurb: Guests rent watercraft on Lake Blue Ridge and receive an in-depth tutorial for safe boating. Rentals include various boats and accessories, with options for delivery to lake houses and captained services. Policies cover deposits, pet limits, and restrictions on personal towables and smoking.
extraNote: No refund if watercraft is out more than 4 hours and returns early due to weather; voucher of $150 if less than 4 hours · Retrieval fee of $300 if rescue needed due to negligence · No personal towables allowed; bringing tubes or skis results in losing deposit · Late arrival fee $50 per 15 minutes at check-in and return · No smoking or grilling on boats; $100 cleaning fee if evidence of smoking · Two-pet limit per boat; $10 per pet cleaning fee; pets not allowed on seats unless covered · Security deposits required, amount varies by boat category; PWC deposits $1500 · Deposits refunded next business day after inspection if no damage and gas used deducted · Loss of deposit does not release rent
